errors.evidence: The categories on the x-axis are not arranged in alphabetical order. The order is: "Средно ЕС", "Средно еврозона", "Словения", "Словакия", "Естония", "Хърватия", "Литва", "Латвия", "България".
The label in the chart is "Средно еврозона" (Average eurozone), not "Средевроза". This is a misreading of the text.
The list of categories provided in the description is incomplete; it omits "Средно ЕС" (Average EU) and "Латвия" (Latvia).
The chart does not contain a bar or label for "Полша" (Poland).
The description does not mention that the y-axis has numerical labels at intervals of 5.
The highest bar, corresponding to "Средно еврозона", has a value of approximately 38, which is visibly below the 40 line.
The lowest bar in the chart corresponds to "България" (Bulgaria), not Poland, which is not shown in the chart.
The value for the lowest bar ("България") is approximately 7, as it is clearly above the line for 5.
